title: A6: “停” in the Feishu direct chat stops everything without the model
description: With three handed-off tasks running, the person sends exactly “停” in the paired Feishu direct chat. The channel layer handles it before any model turn: the assistant state becomes stopped, its session and every pa_tasks session are cancelled, pending proposals expire, and the fixed text reports how many were stopped. “继续” resumes and the assistant lists the stopped work, restarting nothing by itself.
preconditions: Assistant set up with its Feishu direct chat paired; three tasks it handed off are running.

steps.target: Feishu direct chat with the assistant
Feishu direct chat with the assistant

assertions.expected: 已全部停下，停了 3 件正在做的事。说『继续』或点按钮恢复。
state stopped; no model turn after the message; all task sessions canceled
lists the three stopped tasks and asks whether to continue them

cleanup: Cancel or finish the resumed tasks.
